technique: Invariant-manifold view of transformer circuit formation
description: Theory + diagnostics: transformer training dynamics on inductive reasoning tasks collapse to a low-dimensional invariant manifold with interpretable coordinates that can detect which circuits (in-context vs in-weights) were learned.
training_prompt: Given a model's outputs on synthetic inductive tasks (n-gram, multi-hop), propose a minimal set of scalar 'circuit indicators' that distinguish in-context from in-weights learning; then design an experiment to validate the indicators and predict which circuit will dominate under changed data statistics.
expected_improvement: Improves metacognition_accuracy by training DMAI to self-diagnose which internal strategy it is using and predict strategy shifts under distribution changes.

description: Mechanistic bias geometry: biased judging inputs shift activations along a low-dimensional bias subspace; steering/projection along this direction can reproduce or mitigate scoring bias and predict failures on unseen benchmarks.
training_prompt: Design an evaluation harness for DMAI where it acts as an LLM-judge: propose a procedure to detect 'bias directions' from hidden-state features (conceptually), and outline how to use a linear projection to flag likely mis-judgments before final scoring.
expected_improvement: Improves agentic_capability_score and metacognition_accuracy by making DMAI's self-evaluation/verification loops more reliable and debiased.

technique: Requential coding (teacher-selected self-generated samples) for compression/generalization
description: Compression via 'requential coding' where a teacher selects samples from the student's distribution; code length depends on teacher-student disagreement rather than parameter count or data entropy, enabling tighter PAC-Bayes bounds and insight into learnable structure.
training_prompt: Create a DMAI training exercise: given a dataset description and a student/teacher model behavior summary, propose a requential-sampling curriculum that concentrates on disagreement regions and explain how it should change over epochs to avoid overfitting.
expected_improvement: Improves sample_efficiency_trend and recursive_self_improvement_rate by encouraging disagreement-focused self-training curricula and tighter self-assessment of generalization.

technique: Frugal NAS via Transformer RL controller + swarm local search
description: Hybrid NAS: transformer controller trained with RL for global search plus artificial-bee-colony local refinement; adds dynamic entropy to avoid premature convergence and penalizes depth to reduce bloat.
training_prompt: Propose a low-budget architecture-search plan for a new DMAI submodule: specify (1) a global proposal generator, (2) a local mutation/refinement operator, (3) an exploration-stagnation detector, and (4) a size penalty; then justify the choices under a 3-hour RTX-3060 constraint.
expected_improvement: Improves sample_efficiency_trend and transfer_learning_rate by giving DMAI a template for constrained architecture/toolchain optimization loops.

technique: Agent memory layer in minimal code
description: Trending Python project positioning as 'Memory for AI Agents in 5 lines of code'; useful as a reference implementation for lightweight agent memory persistence and retrieval.
training_prompt: Draft a design for a minimal agent-memory API (store, recall, summarize, forget) and specify how DMAI should decide when to write vs retrieve memories during multi-step tool tasks.
expected_improvement: Improves agentic_capability_score and transfer_learning_rate by strengthening long-horizon task continuity and cross-task recall heuristics.

description: Framework for programming (and optimizing) LLM pipelines rather than hand-crafted prompting; relevant for automating prompt/program search and evaluation-driven improvements.
training_prompt: Convert a brittle prompt-based DMAI capability into a small 'program' with modules and an optimizer loop; define the training signal, search space, and stopping criteria.
expected_improvement: Improves zero_shot_success_count and skill_acquisition_rate by turning prompt iteration into structured, evaluable pipeline optimization.

description: Memory primitives aimed at improving long-term agent behavior; relevant to DMAI's conversation/task memory and reflection loops.
training_prompt: Specify a memory schema (episodic, semantic, procedural) and write a policy for how multi-agent DMAI components should share/merge memories without feedback loops or duplication.
expected_improvement: Improves multi_agent_coordination and agentic_capability_score through better shared context management.
